usageNotes: Returns the top-level Ceph directory index for the PDM API, listing available Ceph sub-resources and endpoints. Use this as a discovery call to determine which Ceph operations are exposed before drilling into specific cluster, pool, or OSD endpoints. Accessible to all authenticated users with no additional privilege requirements.

examples.summary: List available Ceph API sub-resources on PDM

tips: The return type is null in the spec, meaning the response is an index array of sub-endpoint names rather than structured Ceph cluster data — parse the links array to discover callable children.
Use this before calling any specific Ceph operation to verify which sub-resources are available on the connected PDM instance.
